channel.description: Latest articles from Las Vegas Review-Journal (reviewjournal.com)

item.title: Super Bowl 60 prediction poll: Lopsided opinions on Patriots-Seahawks
item.description: The Seattle Seahawks are 4½-point favorites over the New England Patriots in Sunday’s Super Bowl, and the total is 45½. A survey of opinions from media, oddsmakers and pro bettors and handicappers.

item.title: Savannah Guthrie in desperate plea to potential kidnappers of her mother: ‘We will pay’
item.description: The frantic search for 84-year-old Nancy Guthrie, Savannah’s mother, has entered a seventh day. Authorities think she was taken against her will from her home just outside Tucson.

item.title: Frontman of 3 Doors Down passes away after long battle with kidney cancer
item.description: The heartbreaking news was shared by the band’s members, who revealed Arnold passed away on Saturday, Feb. 7, while at home, surrounded by loved ones, including his wife, Jennifer Arnold.

item.title: Hill: Enjoy the Super Bowl, San Francisco. It should be your last
item.description: The Super Bowl’s footprint has grown so large in the Bay Area that some of the uniqueness of the game week has been lost.

item.title: Graney: No epic collapse this time — UNLV survives for victory
item.description: The Rebels, coming off a brutal loss at Fresno State on Tuesday, were able to hold off visiting Grand Canyon 80-78.

item.title: ‘Seahawks, Seahawks, Seahawks’: Betting public all over Seattle in Super Bowl
item.description: The Seahawks are popular 4½-point favorites over the Patriots in the Super Bowl as they account for 75 percent of the tickets at BetMGM and 75 percent of the money wagered at Boomer’s Sportsbook.

item.title: Flag football playoff roundup: Gorman stuns Liberty on walk-off TD — PHOTOS
item.description: Bishop Gorman’s flag football team scored two touchdowns in the final minute to defeat Liberty. Here’s a roundup of Saturday’s playoff action.

item.title: SLAM! Nevada rolls to 5th straight 5A wrestling region title — PHOTOS
